figurative_meaning_en: Den, haunt, or birthplace (often of pests, filth, or diseases)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জায়গাটি মশার ডিপো হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This place has become a mosquito depot.
This part of the city is a depot for diseases.
note: Borrowed from English 'depot' and commonly used in contemporary Bengali to denote origins of nuisances.
